summary: Iteration 4: rewrote backend_test.py for the new simplified booking schema (pickup_date+return_date, no duration_type/pickup_time), added coverage for the Telegram approve-from-group bug fix, editable multi-templates (PUT/permissions), and kept regressions (checklist unlock, live stock, admin RBAC, calendar LIVE, CSV export). Pytest = 25/25 PASS. Frontend spot-checked via public URL: catalog title 'Booking Alat', no date/duration picker on catalog, FAB 'Lanjut Booking · N pcs'; checkout has exactly 2 date inputs (checkout-date-input + checkout-return-date-input), 0 time inputs, 0 duration-type toggles; after both dates picked, cart-stock-<code> renders 'sisa N pcs'; submit-order-button POST /api/bookings 200 and navigates to /peminjaman/:id; invoice shows 'Tanggal Pengambilan' + 'Tanggal Pengembalian'; nav labels are 'Booking' and 'Paket'; /peminjaman title 'Booking Saya'; /paket loads Template Paket page. Primary Telegram bug fixed: from.id=random + chat.id=-1003912804350 with data=approve:<bid> now succeeds (booking transitions APPROVED/BORROWED); reject/return_ok/access variants work; random from.id + random chat.id still rejected (booking stays PENDING); webhook w/o secret -> 403; /home from non-admin chat -> handled (200 with rejection message). Google Calendar LIVE verified (simulated=false, calendar_id=yncrewcalendar@gmail.com). Admin CSV export ok.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py telegram_webhook: permission now allows either from.id OR message.chat.id in TELEGRAM_ADMIN_CHAT_IDS — good; consider also validating cq.message.chat.type=='supergroup' and/or logging the effective identity for audit.

BookingInput no longer accepts duration_type — but Pydantic model is not `extra='forbid'`, so old FE payloads with duration_type/duration_hours will be silently accepted and ignored. Consider `model_config = ConfigDict(extra='forbid')` for safety.
create_booking builds start/end using naive 08:00/17:00 WIB; there is no way for a user to book <8h same-day slot anymore. Confirm this is the intended UX (matches request).
PUT /api/templates keeps snapshotted lines.max from item.quantity at edit-time; if admin reduces stock later the cached max becomes stale (already flagged in iter3).
Layout.jsx NavLink for '/peminjaman' likely matches '/paket' due to route matching order — verify with `end` prop or check parent path.

rca of the issue: Telegram approve bug RCA: previous impl only checked from.id against TELEGRAM_ADMIN_CHAT_IDS, but Telegram Groups callbacks carry the human user's personal id in from.id (not the group id). Fix at server.py:648 evaluates `allowed = from_id in admin_ids OR chat_id in admin_ids`, i.e. trusts the admin group chat_id. Verified end-to-end: random from.id + admin group chat.id → booking APPROVED; random from.id + random chat.id → PENDING (rejected).
